# Marshall & Uncle Jim

- [Marshall](../character/marshall.md) — Friend of — [Uncle Jim](../character/uncle-jim.md) — longtime friends and fishing companions · since v4  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P36](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0036)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) visit Captain Jim at the [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds) lighthouse, encountering the oddly bearded [Marshall Elliott](../character/marshall.md) along the lane. During their evening visit, Captain Jim explains Marshall's political vow, shares tea and stories about his cat, [First Mate](../character/first-mate.md), and shows them around the lighthouse.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P0](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P13](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0013), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P32](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0032), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P38](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0038)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) head to the [Four Winds Point](../codex/places.md#four-winds-point) lighthouse to ring in the [New Year](../codex/places.md#new-year) with Captain Jim. They are joined by [Marshall Elliott](../character/marshall.md), who dances with [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) to Captain Jim's fiddle playing. As midnight arrives, the group opens the door to welcome the [New Year](../codex/places.md#new-year) together.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P3](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0003), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P6](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P11](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0011), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P21](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0021)_

> Following an election victory for the Liberals, Captain Jim visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Susan](../character/susan.md) to share the political news. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walks to the lighthouse, where she meets a newly shaved [Marshall Elliott](../character/marshall.md) and speaks with Captain Jim about his feelings on aging and mortality.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT FOUR WINDS

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT FOUR WINDS P6](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT FOUR WINDS P24](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0024), [v4 CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT FOUR WINDS P28](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0028), [v4 CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT FOUR WINDS P34](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0034)_

> [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md) declares his love to [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) in the garden, and she joyfully returns his feelings. Later, Captain Jim joins [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and Owen by the fireplace to share a solemn farewell and bestow a loving blessing upon them all. After the guests depart, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) congratulates [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md), and [Susan](../character/susan.md) returns from the [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) with gossip about [Cornelia](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) Bryant's upcoming marriage.
>
